name: Xiaomi Mijia Water Ion Hair Dryer (Model CMJ01LX) - 1800W Quick Dry
description: Selling a high-performance Xiaomi Mijia Water Ion Hair Dryer (Model: CMJ01LX) [Xiaomi Global](https://www.mi.com/global/product/mi-ionic-hair-dryer-2/). It outputs 1800W of drying power and features a specialized built-in water ion needle that condenses moisture in the air to deeply hydrate hair and prevent frizz. Equipped with NTC intelligent temperature control, it automatically cycles between hot and cold air to protect your scalp from heat damage. It comes with a 360-degree rotatable magnetic nozzle. Note: This is a native 220V Chinese plug device. You will need a step-up voltage converter or proper travel adapter setup to operate it at full capacity in the US. Please note: This comes from a pet-friendly apartment with a resident cat. The hair dryer body and magnetic nozzle have been fully wiped down and sanitized, though minor pet dust particles might remain. It does NOT come with any secondary retail storage packaging or bags, so local pickup buyers, please bring your own tote container.

name_zh: 米家 MIJIA 水离子吹风机 (型号 CMJ01LX) 1800W 大风量速干
description_zh: 低价转让一台非常经典的米家（MIJIA）水离子吹风机（官方型号：CMJ01LX）[小米官网](https://www.mi.com/hair-dryer/specs)。具备 1800W 大功率速干风量，内置核心水离子发生器，能将空气中的水分冷凝并超细微粒化，深度滋润秀发、抚平毛躁。支持 NTC 智能温控及独家冷热风交替循环模式，有效防止头皮过热受损。磁吸式防烫风嘴支持 360° 自由旋转。**特别电压提醒**：本品为国内购买带回的国标 220V 插头，在美国使用需要配合升压变压器或支持相应功率的转接插座。**诚实披露**：家里养猫，属于宠物友好型环境。出货前吹风机身与磁吸风嘴已用酒精彻底擦拭并除尘消毒，但受塑料静电影响可能还会附着极微量猫毛。本个人护理电器不附带原厂纸箱包装或收纳袋，本地自提的买家朋友请自带一个小提袋将其带走。
